_comment: Canonical MCP server list. Every server is streamable HTTP on loopback once serena's entrypoint moves to --transport streamable-http; that one change makes the same four endpoints usable from Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI and Cursor with no stdio shim anywhere. Ports come from hoover4.ini, not from these literals: web-search 21931, browser 21932, whois 21934, serena 21940.
